refuted_approach: Test B (generic divide-and-conquer conversion of a width-w = 2^S read-once branching program of length N): recursion L(N) = w^3 * L(N/2) gives L = N^{3S} leaves (log2 L = 3 S log2 N). With S = N^beta this is far above the target N^{2+beta-eta}, for every beta > 0 (e.g. logN=10, beta=0.25: S=6, log2 L=180 vs target 22.5). Scope: only the naive product recursion; this does NOT rule out other conversions, and the target only needs poly(s) states with S = poly(s), so the generic route is refuted and an MCSP-specific or non-generic conversion is required (consistent with spec negative test B).
